issues.suggestion: Add a terminal goodbye state for clear declines, thanks, or "all set" responses; do not append another help question after the user has closed.
issues.label: Conversation closure

issues.description: The agent makes affordability-sounding judgments without an eligibility review: it called $300 in debts <ref job="SRJ_yPVLRGgd7JjH" item="item_693c7eb4-ee7">"very manageable"</ref> and did the same in an equity-loan call <ref job="SRJ_oeiEjcPhsdeK" item="item_b49b6c22-08d">after hearing $350</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Replace evaluative acknowledgments such as "manageable" or "that timeline works well" with neutral confirmation; reserve affordability and feasibility assessments for the review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Eligibility framing
